To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we show that delexicalized dependency parsers can be transferred between languages, resulting in higher accuracies than previous work, (2) we show that simple constraint based methods can be used to project the final dependency parser from a source to a target language, and (3) we demonstrate that multiple source languages can be used to improve the quality of the resulting parser.
Delexicalized dependency parsers can be effectively transferred between languages.

(a) delexicalized parsers are directly transferable between languages, (b) the quality of the final parser is significantly improved when multiple source languages are used, and (c) the final parser is state of the art in terms of performance when compared to previous work.
